comparison.objective: Candidate mounts a rack rail; record joins two articulated chain ends with a connecting link and side-entry retaining plate.
comparison.physical_skill: Both involve multi-part alignment followed by mechanical retention and release. Candidate handles a long telescoping rail across two fixed posts and adds screw fastening; record aligns flexible chain ends on two pins and slides a forked keeper sideways under pin heads.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks rack-unit alignment, four spring-prong engagements, correct screws, and self-support; record checks both chain holes on pins, keeper slot regions, cradle pose, clearance, and 1 s stability.
comparison.reason: The shared assembly primitive is generic; chain-end synchronization and side-entry keeper capture are meaningfully different from separated rack-post latching. Candidate keeper-equivalent retention tolerances and force limits are missing.
